messages.content: How do I register on the platform?

To register on the platform, click on the Login link in the navigation bar, then select the Register tab. You will need to choose your role as either New Litigant or Helper. Fill in all mandatory fields, including a valid email address, a secure password, and your full name. Finally, click the Register button to create your account.
What information do I need to provide as a Helper?

As a Helper, you need to provide your full name, email, and password during registration. Optionally, you can add your phone number, city, state, and a short bio. When adding a case, you must upload the relevant PDF documents and may be asked to provide the case title, year, court name, or a brief summary.
